definition.en: A basic unit of life. Some organisms contain one cell and others many.
definition.zh: 生命的基本单位。有的生物由一个细胞构成，有的包含许多细胞。

definition.en: A boundary separating cell contents from the surroundings and regulating passage of substances.
definition.zh: 分隔细胞内外、调节物质进出的边界。

definition.en: The cell region outside the nucleus, containing many structures and sites of chemical reactions.
definition.zh: 细胞核以外的区域，包含多种结构，许多化学反应在这里进行。

definition.en: A structure containing genetic instructions and helping control cell activities. Its position varies.
definition.zh: 保存遗传指令、参与控制细胞活动的结构；位置不一定在中央。

definition.en: A supporting, protective structure outside the membrane in a plant cell.
definition.zh: 植物细胞膜外的支持与保护结构。

definition.en: A structure where photosynthesis uses light energy to make food. It contains chlorophyll.
definition.zh: 含叶绿素、利用光能进行光合作用制造食物的结构。

definition.en: A fluid-filled compartment. Mature plant cells often have a large central vacuole containing cell sap.
definition.zh: 含液体的腔室；成熟植物细胞常有含细胞液的中央大液泡。

definition.en: A pigment that absorbs light energy used in photosynthesis.
definition.zh: 吸收光合作用所用光能的色素。

definition.en: An instrument that magnifies small objects for observation. This topic uses a compound light microscope model.
definition.zh: 放大微小物体以供观察的仪器；本主题使用复式光学显微镜模型。

definition.en: The lens assembly on the observer’s side of a microscope.
definition.zh: 显微镜上靠近观察者的镜组。

definition.en: The lens assembly close to a microscope specimen.
definition.zh: 显微镜上靠近标本的镜组。

definition.en: A glass support carrying a thin specimen for microscope observation.
definition.zh: 承载薄标本、供显微镜观察的玻璃片。

definition.en: A thin glass piece covering a prepared specimen on a slide.
definition.zh: 覆盖在载玻片标本上的薄玻璃片。

definition.en: How much larger an image appears than its object. Enlarging a blur need not reveal more detail.
definition.zh: 图像相对物体放大的程度；放大模糊图像不一定增加细节。

definition.en: A structure made of cells working together; tissues contribute to organs.
definition.zh: 由协同工作的细胞构成的结构；组织参与组成器官。

definition.en: A body part made of tissues contributing to a function, such as a leaf or small intestine.
definition.zh: 由组织构成、执行一定功能的部分，例如叶或小肠。
